name: Mobile gas turbine power plants
applications: bridge power while a permanent plant is built
principle: Aeroderivative gas turbines (LM2500, Industrial Trent 60, FT8, LM6000) packaged on trailers or single-lift skids with generator, enclosure and auxiliaries, so a complete simple-cycle power plant ships by road, sea or air and reaches full load within days to weeks of arrival. Units are fleet-operated for rental bridge power (APR Energy) or sold as packages (GE Vernova TM2500, PROENERGY PE6000), typically 20 to 50 MW each and multipliable to hundreds of MW.

reference_plants.capacity: TM2500 mobile generators on two-trailer assemblies, more than 25 MW per unit, delivering electricity to Indonesia's remote areas (2016)

advantages: Fastest capacity addition of any thermal option: weeks from contract to grid
Relocatable, so units move between projects over a fleet life
Multi-unit fleets reach several hundred MW with per-unit redundancy
limitations: Simple-cycle efficiency near 35-40%, well below combined cycle
Headline ratings are ISO; net site output in hot climates is lower
Siemens Energy has withdrawn the SGT-A45 TR mobile package from its portfolio, leaving fewer OEM offers
